holiday_calendars_subdivision_ck.name: holiday_calendars_subdivision_ck
holiday_calendars_subdivision_ck.value: "holiday_calendars"."subdivision" is null or length("holiday_calendars"."subdivision") between 2 and 20

accounts_synced_provider_ck.name: accounts_synced_provider_ck
accounts_synced_provider_ck.value: "accounts"."origin" = 'manual' or ("accounts"."provider" is not null and "accounts"."provider_account_id" is not null)

budget_alerts_scope_ck.name: budget_alerts_scope_ck
budget_alerts_scope_ck.value: "budget_alerts"."category_id" is not null or "budget_alerts"."account_id" is not null

budget_limits_scope_ck.name: budget_limits_scope_ck
budget_limits_scope_ck.value: "budget_limits"."category_id" is not null or "budget_limits"."account_id" is not null

document_evidence_bbox_ck.name: document_evidence_bbox_ck
document_evidence_bbox_ck.value: "document_evidence"."bbox" is null or (cardinality("document_evidence"."bbox") = 4 and "document_evidence"."page" is not null)

instruments_key_ck.name: instruments_key_ck
instruments_key_ck.value: "instruments"."isin" is not null or "instruments"."figi" is not null

investment_events_note_ck.name: investment_events_note_ck
investment_events_note_ck.value: "investment_events"."note" is null or length(btrim("investment_events"."note")) between 1 and 200

investment_operations_sign_ck.name: investment_operations_sign_ck
investment_operations_sign_ck.value: ("investment_operations"."kind" not in ('deposit', 'sell', 'close', 'income') or "investment_operations"."amount_cents" >= 0) and ("investment_operations"."kind" not in ('withdrawal', 'buy', 'fee') or "investment_operations"."amount_cents" <= 0)

investment_plans_size_ck.name: investment_plans_size_ck
investment_plans_size_ck.value: ("investment_plans"."amount_cents" is null) <> ("investment_plans"."quantity" is null) and ("investment_plans"."amount_cents" is null or "investment_plans"."amount_cents" > 0) and ("investment_plans"."quantity" is null or "investment_plans"."quantity" > 0)

investment_plans_day_ck.name: investment_plans_day_ck
investment_plans_day_ck.value: "investment_plans"."day" between 1 and (case when "investment_plans"."frequency" = 'week' then 7 else 31 end)

investment_plans_fee_ck.name: investment_plans_fee_ck
investment_plans_fee_ck.value: ("investment_plans"."fee_cents" is null or "investment_plans"."fee_cents" >= 0) and ("investment_plans"."fee_rate" is null or "investment_plans"."fee_rate" >= 0) and ("investment_plans"."fee_cents" is null or "investment_plans"."fee_rate" is null)

pocket_movements_sign_ck.name: pocket_movements_sign_ck
pocket_movements_sign_ck.value: case "pocket_movements"."kind" when 'accrual' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" > 0 when 'deposit' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" > 0 when 'withdrawal' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" < 0 else "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" <> 0 end

subscriptions_every_ck.name: subscriptions_every_ck
subscriptions_every_ck.value: ("subscriptions"."every_unit" is null and "subscriptions"."every_count" is null) or ("subscriptions"."every_unit" = 'week' and "subscriptions"."every_count" between 1 and 12) or ("subscriptions"."every_unit" = 'month' and "subscriptions"."every_count" between 1 and 24)

fund_contribution_sources_components_ck.name: fund_contribution_sources_components_ck
fund_contribution_sources_components_ck.value: ("fund_contribution_sources"."kind" = 'payroll') = ("fund_contribution_sources"."components" is not null) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."components" is null or (cardinality("fund_contribution_sources"."components") between 1 and 3 and "fund_contribution_sources"."components" <@ array['worker', 'employer', 'tfr']::text[]))

fund_contribution_sources_period_ck.name: fund_contribution_sources_period_ck
fund_contribution_sources_period_ck.value: ("fund_contribution_sources"."kind" = 'payroll') = ("fund_contribution_sources"."accrual_period" is not null) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."accrual_period" is null or "fund_contribution_sources"."accrual_period" in ('month', 'quarter'))

fund_contribution_sources_due_ck.name: fund_contribution_sources_due_ck
fund_contribution_sources_due_ck.value: ("fund_contribution_sources"."due_day" is null) = ("fund_contribution_sources"."due_offset_months" is null) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."due_day" is null or ("fund_contribution_sources"."due_day" between 1 and 31 and "fund_contribution_sources"."due_offset_months" between 0 and 3)) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."tolerance_days" is null or "fund_contribution_sources"."tolerance_days" between 0 and 120)

fund_contribution_sources_interval_ck.name: fund_contribution_sources_interval_ck
fund_contribution_sources_interval_ck.value: ("fund_contribution_sources"."kind" = 'bank_debit') = ("fund_contribution_sources"."interval_count" is not null) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."interval_count" is null) = ("fund_contribution_sources"."interval_unit" is null) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."interval_count" is null or ("fund_contribution_sources"."interval_count" between 1 and 120 and "fund_contribution_sources"."interval_unit" in ('week', 'month', 'year')))

fund_contribution_sources_debit_ck.name: fund_contribution_sources_debit_ck
fund_contribution_sources_debit_ck.value: ("fund_contribution_sources"."amount_cents" is null or "fund_contribution_sources"."amount_cents" > 0) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."debit_day" is null or "fund_contribution_sources"."debit_day" between 1 and 31) and ("fund_contribution_sources"."payee_match" is null or length(btrim("fund_contribution_sources"."payee_match")) between 1 and 80)

fund_contribution_sources_validity_ck.name: fund_contribution_sources_validity_ck
fund_contribution_sources_validity_ck.value: "fund_contribution_sources"."valid_to" is null or "fund_contribution_sources"."valid_from" is null or "fund_contribution_sources"."valid_to" >= "fund_contribution_sources"."valid_from"

fund_fees_value_ck.name: fund_fees_value_ck
fund_fees_value_ck.value: ("fund_fees"."amount_cents" is null) <> ("fund_fees"."rate" is null) and ("fund_fees"."amount_cents" is null or "fund_fees"."amount_cents" > 0) and ("fund_fees"."rate" is null or ("fund_fees"."rate" > 0 and "fund_fees"."rate" <= 1))

fund_fees_period_ck.name: fund_fees_period_ck
fund_fees_period_ck.value: ("fund_fees"."basis" in ('periodic', 'on_assets')) = ("fund_fees"."period" is not null) and ("fund_fees"."period" is null or "fund_fees"."period" in ('month', 'quarter', 'year'))

fund_fees_validity_ck.name: fund_fees_validity_ck
fund_fees_validity_ck.value: "fund_fees"."valid_to" is null or "fund_fees"."valid_from" is null or "fund_fees"."valid_to" >= "fund_fees"."valid_from"

fund_operations_quarter_ck.name: fund_operations_quarter_ck
fund_operations_quarter_ck.value: ("fund_operations"."competence_year" is null) = ("fund_operations"."competence_quarter" is null) and ("fund_operations"."competence_quarter" is null or "fund_operations"."competence_quarter" between 1 and 12)

payslips_extra_number_ck.name: payslips_extra_number_ck
payslips_extra_number_ck.value: ("payslips"."kind" = 'extra') = ("payslips"."extra_number" is not null) or "payslips"."kind" is null

payslips_period_kind_ck.name: payslips_period_kind_ck
payslips_period_kind_ck.value: ("payslips"."kind" is distinct from 'ordinary' or "payslips"."period" is not null) and ("payslips"."kind" is distinct from 'extra' or "payslips"."period" is null)

payslips_period_ck.name: payslips_period_ck
payslips_period_ck.value: "payslips"."period" is null or (extract(day from "payslips"."period") = 1 and extract(year from "payslips"."period") = "payslips"."year")

leave_days_external_ck.name: leave_days_external_ck
leave_days_external_ck.value:
coalesce("leave_days"."external_kind" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,39}$', true)
        and coalesce("leave_days"."external_fraction" in (0.5, 1.0), true)
        and coalesce("leave_days"."external_state" in ('synced', 'refused'), true)

generated.as: case when parent_id is null then null else true end

transactions_waiting_idx.name: transactions_waiting_idx
transactions_waiting_idx.where: "transactions"."category_id" is null and "transactions"."category_key" is not null
